snippet.title: Potato.exe - A Game About Spinning a Wheel to Download Potatoes - Teaser
snippet.description:
Potato.exe - A Game About Spinning a Wheel to Download Potatoes

A non-idle, wheel-spinning clicker. Spin the wheel to earn potatoes, you have a 20% chance. Collect potatoes, buy upgrades, increase your odds... Can you win ten times in a row? Pay attention to what's on screen: Hidden stories, extra upgrades, cats, and very sexy potatoes.

🎮 Wishlist Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5179880/Potatoexe__A_Game_About_Spinning_a_Wheel_to_Download_Potatoes/

In this InEv Games video, we dive deep into the world of game design and game development, offering insights for both beginners and experienced game devs. Learn the key principles of video game design, from understanding game design theory to applying it in real-world indie game development projects. Whether you're looking to discover how to make a game from scratch, or you're an indie game dev exploring advanced techniques, this video has you covered. We'll also share game design tips for creating engaging gameplay, mastering Unity game dev, and building a successful career as a game designer. Stay tuned for more indie game devlogs, practical tutorials, and advice to help you succeed in the game development world, only on InEv Games!
